scope: Local within-participant usability rehearsal, not a production ROI or new model-quality benchmark
sampling: TRAIN only; one pair per supplied IT class, distinct similarity groups across all 16 cases; deterministic hash seed and approximate text-length matching without model predictions
assignment: One member of each pair per arm; within-arm task order hashed rather than class-ordered; arm order counterbalanced by study ID hash and frozen before starting
reference_labels: Publisher-supplied labels hidden during both arms; concordance, not adjudicated correctness
timing: Server UTC elapsed time from opening the assigned batch, including importing its prepared rows, assisted inference/waiting, review/corrections and preparing the output file; includes pauses and reruns; excludes study setup, external CSV creation, download/network/helpdesk delivery and future operating costs
completion: Explicit category confirmation for every row; assisted mode requires a recorded suggestion attempt for every row, including visible failed outcomes
analysis: Only after both arms complete; elapsed totals, elapsed per case, supplied-label concordance, corrections and failures; retain negative differences, aborted and automated-test attempts; no automatic outlier removal or financial extrapolation
limits: Small single-participant processed-text rehearsal; learning/order/task-difficulty and previously trained examples limit inference; new representative operational data are needed for production conclusions
